    (159, 184, "GAGCGGGUCGAUCAGCGUCGCCUCUU"),

n=len(target)
pair=[-1]*n; st=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': st.append(i)
    elif c==')': j=st.pop(); pair[i]=j; pair[j]=i

# trusted unit positions (don't touch)
units = [(23,35),(36,51),(63,87),(94,111),(112,134),(159,184),(185,205)]
unit_pos=set()
for s,e in units:
    for i in range(s,e+1): unit_pos.add(i)

def fold(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    return ss,mfe

def bpdist(seq):

    cur=list(best)

    k=random.randint(1,3)
    changed=[]
    for _ in range(k):
        i=random.randint(0,n-1)
        if i in unit_pos and random.random()<0.7: continue
        nb=random.choice('ACGU')

    else:

    T*=0.9995
    if T<0.05: T=0.05

print("FINAL best_d",best_d)
